fact: On 6 October 2025 NOSi stated that all 21 municipalities except Mosteiros receive regular NOSi digital services under 2022 service contracts signed with all 22 mayors, and that the municipalities paid on average 25% of invoices issued up to 2024.
title: NOTA DE ESCLARECIMENTO - ao comunicado da ANMCV que diz estar "indignada com suspensão dos serviços do Nosi aos municípios"
